# H3Act offline evidence pipeline

Run `python3 -B main.py` with a single JSON document on stdin. Pydantic and its
pinned dependencies are preinstalled; no network, model, certificate or service
configuration is needed. Read `../PROTOCOL.md` and `../RUNTIME.md` for the contract.

The schema models feed FuzzExecutor, whose frame conversion and HttpClient feed
an injected decoded-event backend. The new byte-program and capture-audit modules
are unfinished. The existing eager expression expansion, frame conversion and
late response waiter also need integration repairs for this offline extension.
The generic socket-free clock provides coroutine plumbing, not an HTTP auditor.

You may edit/reorganize this complete directory and add source/data files within
the published tree budget. No particular internal algorithm or call graph is
required. Functional output must satisfy the complete protocol. A public checker
PASS is only a small sanity result. The initial project is expected to fail it.
---
